scripts.preview: npm run build && wrangler pages dev dist --d1=DB=groceree
scripts.db:seed:local: node scripts/build_seed_sql.mjs && wrangler d1 execute groceree --local --file=./schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute groceree --local --file=./seed/seed.sql
scripts.db:seed:remote: node scripts/build_seed_sql.mjs && wrangler d1 execute groceree --remote --file=./schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute groceree --remote --file=./seed/seed.sql
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist
